# Digital Commons at St. Mary's University

> An institutional repository hosting open-access scholarly works, research collections, and academic publications from St. Mary's University and its School of Law.

Digital Commons at St. Mary's University is a comprehensive digital repository powered by bepress that aggregates faculty publications, student scholarship, theses, dissertations, and law journal articles. The platform serves as a centralized hub for discovering and accessing St. Mary's University's academic research across multiple schools and departments.

## Repository Discovery & Browsing

- [Digital Commons at St. Mary's University](https://commons.stmarytx.edu): Homepage for St. Mary's University Digital Commons institutional repository
- [Browse by Research Unit, Center, or Department](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/communities.html): Browse research units, departments, and collections at St. Mary's University
- [Browse by Author](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/authors.html): Browse and search authors in Digital Commons repository
- [Featured Publications](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/featured.html): Showcase of featured academic journals and publications from St. Mary's
- [Most Popular Papers](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/topdownloads.html): Most downloaded and popular papers from Digital Commons repository
- [Most Recent Additions](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/recent_additions.html): Recently added scholarly works and publications to Digital Commons

## Law School Repository

- [Law School Repository](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/law): Law School Repository for St. Mary's University School of Law scholarship
- [Litigating State Capital Cases While Preserving Federal Questions](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/thestmaryslawjournal/vol29/iss4/6): Law journal article on capital punishment and federal court access

## User Support & Access

- [Please Log In](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/cgi/myaccount.cgi): User login and authentication page for Digital Commons account access
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/faq.html): FAQs covering deposits, submissions, and Digital Commons features
- [Custom Email Notifications and RSS](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/announcements.html): Email notifications and RSS feed subscription options for Digital Commons

## About & Information

- [About Institutional Repositories](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/about.html): Information about Digital Commons institutional repository and policies
- [Activity by Year](https://commons.stmarytx.edu/activity.html): Repository statistics and activity metrics by year for Digital Commons
